figurative_meaning_bn: কচি, সতেজ ও আকর্ষণীয় বস্তু বা ব্যক্তি
figurative_meaning_en: Something fresh, tender, and appealing, often referring to youth or attractiveness
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার ডগলা বয়সে খুব সুন্দর দেখতে।
example_sentences_in_english: He brought the freshest greens from the market.
She looks beautiful in her tender youth.
note: Commonly used in rural Bengali contexts to describe fresh produce or youthful appeal
